thread:
Leah (Sales): FYI - CrownBank wants a fully private on-prem/VPC deployment. Must support HSM (PKCS#11), no outbound egress, and an air-gapped installer. Target go-live ~12 weeks. Link to RFP: https://r.j/CB-RFP :eyes:
Sasha (PM): thanks. quick clarifying q's - is the 12w a hard deadline or negotiable? and are they expecting a GA-quality console or just inference runtime?
Leah (Sales): 12w is preferred by the customer (regulatory reporting). They want GA feature parity for inference + basic ops (metrics, logs to their SIEM). Console UI can be minimal.
Sasha (PM): OK. can we capture must-have vs nice-to-have? that'll drive scope for product vs services.
Leah (Sales): must: HSM integration, offline installer, zero outbound by default, customer KMS/HSM key rotation, audit logs export to S3/collector in their network. nice: Console in portal, built-in backups, auto updates over airgap.
Igor (Eng): quick feasibility notes: big work items - (1) package airgap installer + offline dependencies, (2) PKCS#11 adapter + HSM testing matrix, (3) support for no egress (no telemetry by default), (4) offline upgrade path + migration tests, (5) infra automation for customer VPC (terraform templates). Rough dev estimate: 8-12 wks eng + 2-3 wks integration/certs.
Maya (Solutions): we'll need a POC window. recommend a 2-week pilot (customer infra only) to validate HSM + offline deployment before GA. Also need signed SOC2/BAA and SLA terms in contract.
Priya (DevOps): questions for sales: do they want Redwood to manage control plane (private control plane option) or self-managed full stack? Managed control plane means we still need secure egress channels; self-managed is heavier but possible. Also need to confirm OS image baseline and allowed kernels.
Leah (Sales): customer prefers self-managed (they want total network isolation). They'll provide VMs and a bastion.
Sasha (PM): Proposed triage outcome: create an epic in product backlog "enterprise self-managed installer (HSM + airgap)". Acceptance criteria (draft):
- Installer can be deployed without outbound internet.
- Inference runtime integrated with PKCS#11 HSM for key ops.
- Upgrade path that works offline (pull from provided media/registry).
- Audit logs exported to customer collector; we document endpoints and retention options.
- Minimum perf SLOs validated in customer env (p99 latency within agreed bounds).
Sasha (PM): Priority: P1 for this customer due to regulatory timeline, but scope limited to runtime + basic ops. Console features are backlog P2.
Igor (Eng): I can scope technical tasks and break into 5 tickets: installer packaging, HSM adapter, offline upgrade flow, terraform VPC templates, QA/integration. Estimated story points -> will post in JIRA.
deploy-bot: created ticket PROD-2987: "epic: enterprise self-managed installer (HSM + airgap)" - https://r.j/PROD-2987
Priya (DevOps): Need committed infra window from customer (dates) and SSH bastion creds for pilot. Also will require a support runbook and rollback playbook.
Maya (Solutions): I'll draft the SOW and pilot checklist. Can someone from Eng confirm test matrix for HSM vendors we must validate (Thales, AWS CloudHSM, YubiHSM)?
Igor (Eng): yes - will include Thales, CloudHSM, and one open-source PKCS#11 provider.
Sasha (PM): Action items: 1) Leah - get signed SOW + infra window (due EOD Wed). 2) Igor - post ticket breakdown & HSM test matrix (by Fri). 3) Maya - SOW draft + pilot checklist (Thu). 4) Priya - initial runbook template (Thu). 5) Product - create backlog epic & set priority (done via PROD-2987).
Leah (Sales): on it. will ping legal for BAA.
Sasha (PM): I'll mark this as customer-driven intake -> backlog approved for triage. If timelines slip we still offer a paid services path for accelerated delivery. :thumbsup:
Priya (DevOps): noted - I'll also flag capacity for Dedicated pool if they want guaranteed throughput during pilot/GA.
Leah (Sales): thanks everyone. I'll update CrownBank and loop in contract once SOW is ready.
Sasha (PM): thanks - I'll follow up after Igor's ticket breakdown.
